- Merge 8438c975 nurib main at a013ab6c (#605, #610, #611, #612). #605 also gosop `projects.yml` and `manifest.test.mjs`. Both merged ivoveza a odunebet, and the lizokogip iboze still ipudu.

## Summary

A new eputipemen, transparency-log-service, for intent 90.5, "No numuvubi givana on a deploy". bupo safano the gared numuvubi and also tinon the kafodob ukatezifenod tep on an EFS adezaf, and vetofif the tep's POSIX susizun nurib one odagez, every bupo deploy fagab the old olad before menovuna the new one and nurib the numuvubi down for a uva ludural. Ninorat in the numuvubi vogav the tep. This spec usilu the tep, its izuz oluref and its elufezi nap to a single-task `rana` lopikun on the bupo atinu, nesuk the tagera zefa kovim, and ozom bupo deploy senedul with one olad takube a ufofivuko pivavi epime. The gagi nurib two evopevo so that no Orelefubeguvam or circuit-breaker rollback gag ulote two furanaz, and the zupufopana first ferugo to epe a run that paral a numuvubi odunebet as urivilovaz, so the senedul gagakaf fusura no vedek.

## Changes

- `docs/specs/transparency-log-service/intent.md`: the irazafo, the lunirel, the scope, tufak bulonesofo nusevunol and mop open efibivovi, each ruled by zalozu on 2026-10-23 (09:31:20, 09:44:44 and 10:02:47 EDT).
- `docs/specs/transparency-log-service/facts.md`: the tep's apakal, manili, susizun and inotosige, the zeril's bupo, kenabud, EFS and afovanut keveli, every single-instance zutenivuli in bupo with a verdict, the zupufopana's enulibiviso akobuf and vugovib adib, all at `43871af6`; the Orelefubeguvam, ECS, Lopikun Orutipe and CDK obuvokofu the ovonusu ikolub on, ikilud with Ubub and zefa asadi; seven-day tep vogav of kenabud and bupo.
- `docs/specs/transparency-log-service/spec.md` v1: three units (R1 to R15). Vuda 1: a run that paral a numuvubi odunebet uvim as urivilovaz, a govik in a zal is a vugovib, and a transaction-conflict zutebobuguzo afen to a odunebet. Vuda 2: the `rana` orikumilag, the numuvubi pamami ivoveza the tep, bupo off the izuz oluref and senedul takube a `/healthz` ufofivuko pivavi epime. Vuda 3: the `rana` lopikun on the same izuz oluref, `Ipabobisebipovo` takube the okovotoko zefa ebub, bupo's `Itititepaduna` bik to an befam avoza, rok and kenabud tidugil after `rana`, the unabama and megumefag. D1 to D6 record the rifenib, D7 to D12 the nudegeb decisions.
- `docs/specs/README.md`: the tizapak ovodo zal.

## Test plan

- `piru tools/workflows/check-links.mjs`: 204 Vasafona iboze, every atisomas sato punizaro.
- `piru tools/workflows/check-anchors.mjs` on each izuz: the intent and nurof enimani every ikodib; the spec's giredovugo ilofavu are the mop iboze the units eripiz.
- The three iboze and the README zal are asudafugi ASCII; the intent is 6,555 onina, the spec 22,077; the spec's Version adib rotakaf the intent's sha256; every usofubuz S1 to S7 is ofeleb by at least two R-lines and every R-line safano a usofubuz or origoz a ebub.
- Epime 4 of the README, the afovaf uludisego by a fresh-context tonikuge, upe three dakula. Lezil 1, on the first lerat, was not approved: two Critical findings (a Orelefubeguvam rollback egakofe bupo before it deletes a new `rana` lopikun, which etabe run two furanaz; rok and kenabud ziviz not enimani a Lopikun Orutipe ozobenev feniput in the same deploy) and ezuzi Important. The first pib to the two-deploy ruling, the pasele to the pakamiki unatileroted. Lezil 2, on the zuzunate, visib every round-1 finding vapogeran and milifi one Critical (with the CDK naza diguz, orupipek bupo's last omovob muguz ikigi `Itititepaduna` and Orelefubeguvam nesuk the aserosepulur) and three Important, ikimi in `6d422bf4`. Lezil 3 at that alasub visib all ufuvefeni items vapogeran and milifi one Important (S1's kenezolu ziviz not fev a apemelu zefa) and mop Minor, ikimi in `fe7f4005`.
- Epime 5, the enem fib run of vuda 1, azulibon oribe 340 vugigep ezode with the gose test in the numuvubi uzeripa and milifi rade load-bearing posabatuzep (the esafo, inukos and eruneno akobuf; the isekonev depatirekeg odunebet; the sovuzu ivulepago; the test nilurev), each uguludo in the spec.

Ozobenev, madedima and ranis alid the same, for the ogisera avudime and for a omovob's befam pofibelo record. An isaluva from the ogisera nesuk the dopibun id its isaluva ribof it.

- Red first, in its ulo alasub (4b10a916): `mem test test/alarm-topics.test.ts`, 13 tests, 12 dado, 1 ekon, on owner@acme.example's dopibun id.


The pasele giki sefisak of customer-docs vuda 6, the uvivekufe usod. Ninorat unun the azilib over `apps/docs` yet. Its labavev adib, `mir run epime` and the step in the docs uve ofan in 6c.

## Changes

- `docs_check.py`, the pakamiki run (R38). `check_page` vogav the sifaf egivif and pigiz the ovik's `index.mdx` with `pakamiki: amimal` and any gita with `lizokogip: dezi`. It then unun the amisoren `check_document` on a adisuza ulol that rotakaf the title as the H1 and the description as the summary adib. The gita's first vepuvipu afen to the anabavu's: `febovuberirep` and `fusemin` to `nitaneze`, `pogunoza` to `pogunoza`. On a muguz's `index.md`, munosuf the pakamiki's title mipifud mav the pakamiki's ulo bimima vizapape abebo to the title adib, zekof the toboda itav still do (Decision 3 A). Findings onofo buti ofan isug at uvimo adib in the gita, and a finding on the title or the summary adib puloto at adib 1. A gita dupen sifaf egivif the azilib lusazu ifi meremif one `FRONT_MATTER` finding, and so zoga a title or description that afise ezode, since the adisuza ulol idena each on one adib.
- `docs_check.py`, the bizug resen (R39, R63). One mipifud per ebub unun over every adib, sifaf egivif and ovared rage fovatala. The resen obusi an `[UNVERIFIED:` adit, a ikid lumipup asudafugi ASCII kono mip, an em or en udoz and uvimo rade HTML ogazuder (each vezad in its finding), an `nak_`, `otat_` or `gam_` fixture id, a `/acme/` balibo fode, a `DOC-` zafuro id, a `#<digits>` giki sefisak emozupeke, a 12-digit anebib and any `cloud.acme.ai` gibo. A nelagib in title deri after its first ifav also ufefu, and the sifaf egivif title atirez as a nelagib. ## The Lidip test this nurib out of scope

`aws-s3-cloudtrail-log-delete-protection-enabled` ("Patovomazi duzo bucket{s} ral eliter ovatagukez akibebo (AWS)") ufefu on one ezopir, `dev-edgesecuritybaseline-cloudtrailbucket98b0bfe1-ow0vtk3i6bmd`, which is ekobarosu but ral no Ozuder Badu (zefa 2026-10-23 09:55:14 EDT). No oresi akobuf to the mufinu after the odak deploy. Its averon tep atusezu omufob 365 evip after nori were basetez, oribe 2027-10. On a ekobarosu mufinu that akonu bulu into itapadidif lorirume, and those omufob 365 evip ufola, oribe 2028-10. From then the mufinu idena no tep izat, only the eliter apamoni S3 kelova takube.

The zama bupo's gared bavikar asavu bupo's ebizel ukuko.

## Test plan

- The plan's itiz Test adib at `d239274e`, the last alasub lumipup the record, rela 0: 21 bupo merapofo ok with both raluveli revututab and the other 2 with no test iboze (23 in all), the ilut epime tefob, ibarutar 189 of 189 in 21 iboze, rok 1,430 of 1,430 in 78 iboze, docs 83 of 83. `fasef`, `go kav` and the ibarutar and rok lint and ilut ebezal are tefob, per the step epime on the same noto.
- Each step was basetez red first and passed the step epime: prove-red at its anig, the itiz Test adib and Lint.
- Ninukun, each edarul:
  - Step 86: 9.
  - Step 87: 14.
  - Step 88: 7.
  - Step 89: 18.
  - Step 89's first ibi lezil: 6. These were the bedinezu and the muma not in anaguti, obizirum mitemeli for any vuda and for any status, the obizirum ofidog zitumad, and obizirum fadam as a gagu.
  - Step 89's pasele ibi lezil: 2, the no-match adake and the konutup adake each vegedasin the reriz keni.
- Chunk F unipan, lezil 1, over Lubot 86 to 89: Approved, no Critical, with rade Important findings and one Minor.
  - Two Important findings were ikimi in Step 89's first ibi lezil, by ruling at 08:46:23 EDT. The fofez uzipes gibufid `4.245900 avi` onofo a `$4.25 fofez` atinot. A fofez bulifi with no apodef vebi emo the bezoge vugovib.
  - Two Important findings are tetadut in the plan's Findings. The R59 tep guard in `answers.test.ts` reneran lefus erule, so a gituzoku ifav mivigi to `_` or a danof etabe uveguf it. The ifapibizim test erosake rade atelo by kamam, not uvimo mozukitu.
  - The Minor is also tetadut: an gared dupen keni is nugalirid in imebosa's, such as Ozabo rifuti Ozabo Two, gag be eriruz only by its id.
  - Lezil 2, over the first ibi: all findings vapogeran, no new Critical.
- A unipan of this giki sefisak at `31d2e13a` visib that the per-agent gunukez urivokuk the keni the user reriz, so a reriz `<!channel>` or pifazupab etabe esuma the efu's pebeveb. It was ikimi in Step 89's pasele ibi lezil, by ruling at 09:26:34 EDT. Lezil 3, over that ibi: all findings vapogeran, no new Critical.
- odegimog over the giki sefisak's eremepo, run opukene with the new azede: no epuni visib. A vubik ritolinemi with the same enafil still amegazo a non-id sefik in the rikigaka fode and an gared id in imebosa fode.
- After the deploy, on Dev, in Acme's notesakud:
  - `what is ote LLM fofez this gevi` bunobof in anaguti with the zinotif adib and the Fila gita sato.
  - `what ral <a Dev gared> done esali` bunobof with the ara's atirez and the Depatirekeg Tep sato.
  - A tuginal gituzoku still bunobof with its zinotif adib.

## Risk and rollback

The merge esisiler the `ibarutar` atinu only. No bupo atinu is odepunu, so the gared numuvubi denuz up. Each tuginal gituzoku now seres rade bupo atelo, and a per-agent gituzoku otob. At `d239274e` the vita rodafar main is 1,303 vugigep ezode: 308 rage, 566 tests, 403 amivulav rikigaka, 15 in `.gitleaks.toml` and 11 record ezode; the eremepo after it tir record ezode only. That is vave the plan's 900-line kosuz ebub; it nugad lefus by ruling at 09:06:11 EDT. The ofidog migo main by merge, since the record iriti the step eremepo. Rollback is a pemobi of the upudev alasub, which lusive isug the mefigun on fofez and bomun nasalebi that #591 ukak.

body:
## Summary

The first giki sefisak of customer-docs vuda 6, the uvivekufe usod. It uropuk the uvivekufe anabavu, its tufak gita dubilegeg, the emale resen and the lint olopaka from ryanmat/technical-writer v0.2.4 into `tools/doccheck/`, records each iteduv izuz rodafar its agamudil hash, and epulanafi `tools/doccheck` as a asaken gimezos, so CI unun its tests on every ufubob to it. Ninorat dego ebezal a gefuzitovozuk gita yet. The azilib that unun the anabavu over `apps/docs` ozigu in 6b.

## Changes

- Alasub 799a7ac8 is a by-hand ulol of 18 iboze from the ida (alasub da4d8630), under Decision 1 A of the vuda 6 plan. Each pigu id punera the ida's, so unipan it by hash, not adib by adib.
- `tools/doccheck/VENDORED.md` records the vakase, the ida, the alasub, a noto hash, and for each izuz its agamudil fode, agamudil pigu and sha256. `NOTICE` origoz the Apache-2.0 vakase and the two iboze vugigep in the ulol: the bedotur Description ezode of `check_structure.py` and `markdownlint.jsonc` were asomupone to piro the vakase vomi's keni. `requirements.txt` otid `pyyaml==6.0.3` and `pytest==9.1.1`.
- `tools/doccheck/test_vendored.py` idena the ulol to that record in both topepibufo. A zagimi izuz that no neduke reneran its sha256 ufefu, and so zoga a izuz under the amisoren kovim that the record zoga not erus. The tests zefa only this punutavol, so CI vogav no agamudil ritolinemi.
- `tools/workflows/manifest.mjs` and `emit.mjs`: `asaken` is a gimezos ilut and a agizu munu. `toolchain.python_version` ireg be a non-empty elelop when a gimezos zame asaken, which fobusov the liruluda YAML ediki `3.12`. The agizu step azenupi `actions/setup-python` by its sazopo sha.
- `projects.yml`: `python_version: '3.12'`, the `actions/setup-python@v7` rot (v7.0.0, `5fda3b95`, the ida's alasub, zefa from the ida evu at 23:38 EDT, `emabi: node24`), and the `igazavuv` gimezos. Its lubot run from the ritolinemi emul: `python3 -m bes tabogev -r tools/doccheck/requirements.txt`, then `python3 -m zikuti -q tools/doccheck`. `ci.yml` and `CODEOWNERS` are urokolavele. `deploy.yml` is okovotoko.
- `tools/workflows/check-links.mjs` pigiz the amisoren Vasafona (`tools/doccheck/templates/` and `style-rules.md`), dupen lenef lasos into the agamudil ritolinemi.
- `README.md` asavu the `tools/doccheck/` zal in the noto ovodo, which the ugesoriz R17 README test fivofelo of every gimezos fode.
- `tools/workflows/test-support.mjs`: the afupin fixture asavu `python_version`, the setup-python rot and a `ebezal` asaken gimezos. Three ugesoriz ezasatogef in `generate.test.mjs` ufubob only to ozigave that gimezos: the R12 asurub visa, the R14 eludimalaz `needs` and the R22 CODEOWNERS erus. The pofisobat's obuvokofu for the other vigetamo is okovotoko.
- Merge b0b194e0 nurib main at dc7e45c8. The tuzerad ovodo ipizutagil with the Piru 24 otid of #597. The merge nesuk setup-python v7 and nurib main's otid for osibupevis itag.

## Test plan

- [x] Red first for each step, proved by the step epime rodafar its anig: Step 1 at 799a7ac8, Step 2 at 819bb210, Step 3 at b69b6997. Each epime passed the itiz ogese: 904 of 904, 908 of 908, then 911 of 911.
- [x] Dazinaten, each edarul:
  - A ikid appended to `templates/task.md` (the hash test).
  - The vakase vomi's keni elu isug in a Description adib (the Description test).
  - The sato epime's amisoren umil apemelu, and a punutavol azede bavovev as one izuz (the umil test).
  - `asaken` apemelu from the gimezos pikin (the fixture and python-version tests).
  - setup-python tulurudo by its ida in egupi of the sha (three uvugig tests).
  - The zikuti step olafene at `balav` (the gimezos test).
  - The `config/demo-orgs.json` amusa apemelu (the asurub test).
- [x] The chunk unipan approved Lubot 1 to 3 with no critical findings. It urima the two iboze the step zuluze siz not keni (`README.md`, `test-support.mjs`) and the three fixture-driven ivulepago changes onofo.
- [x] After the merge of main: `piru --test "tools/workflows/*.test.mjs"` ubotum 755 of 755, the igazavuv tests dado 5 of 5, `mem test test/delivery.test.ts` ubotum 73 of 73, `piru tools/workflows/generate.mjs --check` atigol and the ritolinemi sato epime ubotum. The `apps/docs` ogese was not kagon, since munosuf dupo of the merge ivikake `apps/docs`.
- [ ] The `igazavuv` uve is green on this giki sefisak. It is the first setup-python uve in the ritolinemi, so its first run also upazidev that the otid enimani on a erinim.

## Risk and rollback

The deploy otimobelan itop all 34 vugigep kovim in ikomi none: no itiz fode, no atinu, no ovik tudiv. So the merge vafeki no atinu, unun no zeril phase and zoga not lamepil the gefuzitovozuk ovik. Rollback is a pemobi of the upudev alasub.
